messages:
maya: Quick sync — running a small experiment next week to test bundle messaging + inbound routing from the pricing page. Goal: fewer FAQ clicks, more qualified demo requests. :rocket:
liam: Nice. What are the primary metrics we’ll use? conversion to demo, MQL rate, and SQL conversion? :thinking_face:
maya: Exactly. Primary: demo requests / unique visitors from pricing. Secondary: reduction in FAQ bounce and avg time on pricing. Tertiary: sales-accepted leads per cohort.
ana: +1 on metrics. We should track form drop-off by tier and by 'bundle' vs 'single-plan' journey.
nana: Also want to iterate on the bundle name — proposing "Starter + Scale" vs "Base + Boost". Which feels clearer to customers?
olivia: "Starter + Scale" reads clearer to me on calls. Keep it simple. Sales prefers descriptive over clever.
liam: For the page flow, I suggest gating the demo CTA for the bundled plan using the calculator step — if a user selects features that exceed X, we show the demo CTA and capture intent.
chris: Agree. I'll add an event for the calc step. Proposed event names: pricing_bundle_calc_open, pricing_bundle_calc_submit, pricing_bundle_demo_cta_click. Thoughts?
maya: Those event names look good. liam suggested adding a property 'calc_score' that sums selected features to define the gating threshold.
chris: I'll instrument that. Quick config snippet we'll use in GTM: 
```
{ "event": "pricing_bundle_calc_submit", "props": { "calc_score": 42, "bundle_variant": "starter_scale_v1" }}
```
liam: Perfect. We'll need an AB test variant map: control = current page, v1 = new bundle copy + calc gating, v2 = new name + simplified calculator.
maya: Ana + Olivia will own v1 copy and v2 copy respectively. Marketing will own funnel analysis and reporting windows (7d, 14d).
ana: For FAQ updates: we should remove duplicate Qs about "committed vs metered" and add a short blurb about "How are usage overages billed?" with the answer linking to billing docs. Keep the FAQ snippet under 2 lines.
olivia: Sales needs a call routing rule: all demo requests from pricing bundle that include "enterprise" or calc_score > 80 route to AE queue A, otherwise go to SDR triage. Can ops add a label on the lead: "pricing-bundle-high-intent"?
chris: I'll add the label via API on form submit. Example request: `POST /leads {"tag":"pricing-bundle-high-intent","score":calc_score}`
launch-bot: Reminder: Marketing experiment feature flag rollout scheduled 2026-05-03 09:00 UTC. Watch for <alerts>.
maya: Timeline — finalize copy by EOD Friday, instrumentation ready Monday, soft rollout to 10% on Wednesday, monitor first 48h and escalate if any spike in error events.
liam: I'll wire up the dashboard: conversions by variant, calc_score distribution, FAQ clickthroughs, lead routing counts.
nana: Copy suggestions: for the short FAQ line — "How are overages billed?" -> "We bill overages monthly at your plan's metered rate; contact billing for upfront caps."
olivia: On hand for demo follow-ups — please tag me on high-intent leads: @olivia
maya: Thanks all — ping here with links to the GA/GTM events and the experiment dashboard when ready. :pray:
